title: MoakPlus Mods
description: Optional Fabric mods that enhance performance, visuals, and gameplay on MoakPlus. No mods are required to join the server.
body:
# MoakPlus Recommended Mods

MoakPlus Recommended Mods is an optional collection of client-side Fabric mods designed to improve performance, visuals, and quality of life while playing on MoakPlus.

## Important

No mods are required to join MoakPlus.  
The server remains fully compatible with vanilla Minecraft.

## Features

- Improved performance and FPS
- Enhanced visuals and lighting
- Quality-of-life improvements
- Better inventory management
- Exploration and mapping tools

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.x
- Fabric Loader

## Server

Join MoakPlus at:

`play.moakplus.com`
